notes.title: The Optimization Launch Update
notes.notes:
[h3]We've introduced numerous optimizations to ensure the game runs smoothly across a wide range of computer configurations on launch day.[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock that was preventing players from advancing past a specific enemy room.
[*] Addressed visual bugs caused by shader issues, resulting in a more visually appealing and immersive environment.
[*] Various minor bugs and issues have been resolved to enhance overall stability and gameplay fluidity.
[/list]

notes.title: Join our live stream and try out the demo during Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Step into the dystopian future of Minimally Invasive, where healthy organs are the new currency and danger lurks within every patient. Join the journey of Cuz, a specialist in trans-species surgery, and his AI partner, Walt, as they face the challenge of saving an alien race from a hate-mongering priest's sinister plans.

🛠️ Master Your Surgical Tools
Take control of your mechanical arms and utilize a variety of tools to solve environmental surgery puzzles. Use the Scanner to probe and analyze, the Grasper to retrieve and manipulate, and the Scalpel for precise cuts and formidable attacks. Engage with the Drill to break through crystalline formations, the Syringe to extract and harness natural substances, and the Laser for cauterizing wounds and defending against threats.

🚑 Command the Bee Bus
Navigate the biological landscapes within your patients with the Bee Bus, a nimble vessel that reaches areas otherwise inaccessible by foot. Traverse through the complex inner workings of your patients' bodies to perform life-saving procedures.

⚠️ Face Unexpected Dangers
Stay alert and brace yourself for the unexpected. Uncover the secrets hidden within your patients and confront the sinister dangers that lie within. Every surgery is a race against time and threats, demanding precision, quick thinking, and strategic use of your tools.

🎮 Watch Our Stream During Steam Next Fest!
Curious to see Minimally Invasive in action? Join our stream during Steam Next Fest! Watch live gameplay, get tips and tricks, and interact with the developers. Don’t miss this chance to delve deeper into the world of Minimally Invasive and see the thrilling gameplay that awaits you.
